bookSourceComment:
如果是用的官方版阅读，或者低版本阅读，推荐更新阅读以使用新功能，否则很多功能无法使用哦
软件下载地址：https://legado.gyks.cf
推荐使用阅读R或者阅读Sigma


晴天聚合重构，已适配所有安卓版本阅读
目前不适配苹果端栖阅(可以正常阅读，发现页无法适配)

更新日志请点击登录，更新书源中查看

基础使用教程：
1、搜索：
    1)基础搜索：在发现页长按该书源，点击搜索，直接搜，搜索范围(全部来源小说)
    2)进阶搜索：在登陆-书源设置中选择指定模式/来源，可搜索指定模式/来源内容
    3)快捷搜索：使用特殊关键词(x,t,m,d,@)搜索
         x:书名@来源  如(x:十日终焉@番茄)
         t:书名@来源  如(t:十日终焉@番茄)
         m:书名@来源  如(m:十日终焉@番茄)
         d:书名@来源  如(d:十日终焉@番茄)
         其中：x表示小说(可省略)，t表示听书，m表示漫画，d表示短剧
         冒号支持中文英文
         
2、发现页：
    在书源设置中选择指定模式或者单个来源，然后刷新发现页即可
    
3、更多使用方式进入书源设置页面应该能一目了然

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
var base = baseUrl;
var isLB = base.indexOf('leader-board') > -1;
var headers = buildHeaders(java);
java.put('headers', JSON.stringify({ headers: headers }));
var result;

if (isLB) {
    var qs = base.split('?')[1];
    var ps = {};
    qs.split('&').forEach(function(p) {
        var kv = p.split('=');
        ps[kv[0]] = kv[1];
    });
    signParams(ps, java);
    var u = 'https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v1/leader-board?' + urlEncode(ps);
    result = java.ajax(u + ',' + java.get('headers'));
    var jsonData = JSON.parse(result);

   if (jsonData.data && jsonData.data.character_list) {
    var charList = jsonData.data.character_list;
    var mappedBooks = charList.map(function(item) {
        var bookId = item.book_id || item.work_id || item.id;
        var origin = String(item.sub_title || '');
        var bookName = origin.replace(/^出自\s*/, '') || String(item.nickname || '角色');
        return {
            id: bookId,
            book_id: bookId,
            character_id: item.character_id,
            title: bookName,
            image_link: item.avatar,
            sub_title: '角色：' + String(item.nickname || '未知'), 
            words_num: item.heat_number || '0',
            reader_type: item.reader_type || '0'
        };
    });
    jsonData.data.books = mappedBooks;
    jsonData.data._character_list = jsonData.data.character_list;
}

    var config = {};
    try { var raw = source.getVariable(); if (raw && raw !== '' && raw !== 'null' && raw !== 'undefined') config = JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) {}
    var books = jsonData.data.books || [];
    var needFix = [];
    if (config.authorFix === true || config.introFix === true) {
        for (var di = 0; di < books.length; di++) {
            var book = books[di];
            var needAuthor = (config.authorFix === true) && (!book.author || book.author === '');
            var needIntro = (config.introFix === true) && (!book.intro || book.intro === '');
            if (needAuthor || needIntro) {
                needFix.push(di);
            }
        }
    }

    if (needFix.length > 0) {
        var detUrls = [];
        for (var fi = 0; fi < needFix.length; fi++) {
            var idx = needFix[fi];
            var dp = { id: books[idx].id, imei_ip: '2937357107', teeny_mode: 0 };
            signParams(dp, java);
            detUrls.push('https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v5/book/detail?' + urlEncode(dp) + ',{"headers":' + JSON.stringify(headers) + '}');
        }
        var ress = java.ajaxAll(detUrls);
        for (var ri = 0; ri < ress.length && ri < needFix.length; ri++) {
            try {
                var det = JSON.parse(String(ress[ri].body() || ''));
                var bb = det && det.data && det.data.book;
                if (bb) {
                    var idx = needFix[ri];
                    if (config.authorFix === true && bb.author) {
                        books[idx].author = bb.author;
                    }
                    if (config.introFix === true && bb.intro) {
                        books[idx].intro = bb.intro;
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }
    }

    result = JSON.stringify(jsonData);
} else {
    var g = base.match(/gender=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/gender=(\d+)/)[1] : '';
    var cid = base.match(/category_id=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/category_id=(\d+)/)[1] : '';
    var pg = base.match(/page=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/page=(\d+)/)[1] : '';
    var nf = base.match(/need_filters=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/need_filters=(\d+)/)[1] : '1';
    var nc = base.match(/need_category=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/need_category=(\d+)/)[1] : '0';
    var tid = base.match(/tag_id=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/tag_id=(\d+)/)[1] : '';
    var words = base.match(/words=([^&]+)/) ? base.match(/words=([^&]+)/)[1] : '-99';
    var sort = base.match(/sort=([^&]+)/) ? base.match(/sort=([^&]+)/)[1] : '0';
    var over = base.match(/over=([^&]+)/) ? base.match(/over=([^&]+)/)[1] : '-99';
    var ct = base.match(/category_type=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/category_type=(\d+)/)[1] : '';
    var apiVer = 'v4';
    var match = base.match(/[?&]api=([^&]+)/);
    if (match) apiVer = match[1].toLowerCase();

    var isDynamicCategory = (base.indexOf('api=v5') > -1);

    if (base.match(/category/)) {
        var isV5 = (apiVer === 'v5');
        var ps = {
            gender: g,
            category_id: cid,
            need_filters: nf,
            page: pg,
            need_category: nc,
            words: words,
            sort: sort,
            over: over,
            imei_ip: '2937357107',
            book_privacy: '1',
            read_preference: '0'
        };
        if (ct) ps.category_type = ct;
        if (isV5) {

<js>
var bookId = baseUrl.match(/(\d+)/)[1]
result = java.ajax("https://wxapp.qidian.com/api/book/categoryV2?bookId=" + bookId + "&_csrfToken=")
var charts = [];
JSON.parse(result).data.vs.map(i => {
    i.cs.map(o => {
        var chart = {
            "id": o.id,
            "title": o.cN,
            "v": o.sS == 0,
            "t": o.uT + "  " + o.cnt + "字"
        }
        var content_url = {
            bookId: bookId,
            id: o.id,
            v: o.sS == 0
        }
        content_url = java.base64Encode(JSON.stringify(content_url));
        chart.url = `data:;base64,${content_url},{"type":"qtqd"}`;
        charts.push(chart);
    })
})
charts;
</js>

<js>
try {
    var parsedResult = JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result));
    var cid = parsedResult.id;
    var bookId = parsedResult.bookId;
    var isVip = parsedResult.v;
    java.log(isVip)
    var url;
    if (!isVip) {
        url = `${bu}/api/novel/chapter/${bookId}/${cid}`;
    } else {
        url = `${bu}/api/novel/vip-chapter/${bookId}/${cid}`;
    }
   java.log(url)
    var data = java.ajax(url);
    
    if (!data) {
        java.log('AJAX请求失败');
    }

    try {
       
        var response = JSON.parse(data);

        content = response.data?.content || response.message
    } catch (e) {
        java.log('解析响应JSON失败: ' + e);
    }
} catch (e) {
    java.log('解析初始JSON失败: ' + e);
}
</js>

<js>
token = source.get('token');
if (token == null || token == '') {
    token = source.getVariable();
}
a=java.hexDecodeToString(result)
if(a.match(/juanming/)){
	result=''
}else {
bid=java.hexDecodeToString(result).split(",")[0]
cid=java.hexDecodeToString(result).split(",")[1];
t=chapter.tag.match(/\|\s+(.*)/)[1];
if(chapter.isVip()){
	url=`{{h}}content.php?bookId=${bid}&chapterId=${cid},{"headers":{"tokens": "${token}","chapterTime": "${t}"}}`
	re=java.ajax(url)
	if (JSON.parse(re).code==200){
	c=JSON.parse(re).data
	}else{
		er=JSON.parse(re).error
		java.toast(er)
		c=''
		}
	}else {
   r = String(java.ajax(
        "https://m.qidian.com/chapter/" + bid + "/" + cid + ".html"
    ));
    c = org.jsoup.Jsoup
        .parse(r)
        .select('main#c-' + cid)
        .html();
        c=String(c).replace(/<\/?p>/g,'')
}c
}
</js>
